description: One outreach card for a creator across YouTube, Twitch and Kick (give any of the three usernames): bio, follower/subscriber counts, live status, verified flag, every public social link (Instagram, X, YouTube, Discord, TikTok...) and email addresses written in public bios. Data is what each platform shows publicly; hidden business emails (YouTube 'view email') are not fetched. Unknown usernames are reported per platform. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

youtube.description: YouTube handle, e.g. @xQcOW (handles are not always the same as the streaming name)
